# Introduction

Figure S6A: LOESS regression for cytokine response kinetics in the Null
condition in successfully treated patients who received 24-week
treatment (Arms A and B).

Figure S7A: LOESS regression comparing cytokine response kinetics across all
stimulation conditions (Null, Mtb_Ag, LPS, IL1B) in patients with similar
baseline lung disease (Arms B and C) from the treatment success group (n = 18)
and treatment failure group (n = 2). 

Figure S7B: LOESS regression comparing cytokine response kinetics across all
stimulation conditions (Null, Mtb_Ag, LPS, IL1B) in patients with similar
baseline lung disease (Arms B and C) from the treatment success group (n = 18) and
confirmed relapse group (n = 4).

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_file <- "Input/Cytokines_cleaned_log10_Predict-TB.xlsx"

output_main   <- "Output/Figure_S6A_S7"
output_null   <- "Output/Figure_S6A_S7/S6A_Null"
output_s7a    <- "Output/Figure_S6A_S7/S7A_SuccVsFail"
output_s7b    <- "Output/Figure_S6A_S7/S7B_SuccVsRelapse"

for (d in c(output_main, output_null, output_s7a, output_s7b)) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Filter and recode

```{r}
#| label: filter-recode

protein_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments %in% c("success", "treatment failure", "confirmed relapse")) %>%
  mutate(
    Visit     = as.numeric(Visit),
    Condition = ifelse(Condition == "TB", "Mtb_Ag", Condition),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B")),
    Comments  = factor(Comments,
                       levels = c("success", "treatment failure", "confirmed relapse")),
    Arm       = factor(Arm, levels = c("A", "B", "C"))
  )

cat("Visits present:     ", paste(sort(unique(protein_data$Visit)),    collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Conditions present: ", paste(levels(protein_data$Condition),      collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Outcomes present:   ", paste(levels(protein_data$Comments),       collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Arms present:       ", paste(levels(protein_data$Arm),            collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# Define cytokine columns

```{r}
#| label: define-cytokines

cytokine_cols <- c(

)

cat(sprintf("Cytokines: %d\n", length(cytokine_cols)))
```

# Null subtraction across all stimulation conditions

```{r}
#| label: subtract-null-function

subtract_null_all <- function(df, cytokine) {

  base <- df %>%
    select(ID1, Visit, Condition, Comments, Arm, all_of(cytokine)) %>%
    rename(log10_Value = all_of(cytokine)) %>%
    mutate(
      log10_Value = as.numeric(log10_Value),
      raw_Value   = 10^log10_Value          # back-transform to raw concentration
    )

  # Null raw reference per ID1 x Visit
  ref <- base %>%
    filter(Condition == "Null") %>%
    select(ID1, Visit, raw_Null = raw_Value)

  # Null panel — retain original log10 values as the reference panel
  null_data <- base %>%
    filter(Condition == "Null") %>%
    mutate(
      raw_Null   = raw_Value,
      Subtracted = NA_real_,
      log10_Sub  = log10_Value
    )

  # Stimulated conditions — back-transform, subtract Null, re-transform
  stim_data <- base %>%
    filter(Condition != "Null") %>%
    left_join(ref, by = c("ID1", "Visit")) %>%
    mutate(
      Subtracted = pmax(0, raw_Value - raw_Null),
      log10_Sub  = log10(1 + Subtracted)
    )

  bind_rows(null_data, stim_data) %>%
    mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B")))
}
```

# Figure S6A — Null LOESS kinetics in success group (Arms A and B)

```{r}
#| label: plot-s6a-function

plot_s6a <- function(df, cytokine, save_dir) {

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      Arm       %in% c("A", "B"),
      Comments  == "success",
      Condition == "Null"
    ) %>%
    select(ID1, Visit, all_of(cytokine)) %>%
    rename(Value = all_of(cytokine)) %>%
    mutate(Value = as.numeric(Value)) %>%
    drop_na(Value)

  if (nrow(dat) < 5) {
    message(sprintf("S6A — %s: too few rows (%d), skipping.", cytokine, nrow(dat)))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Visit, y = Value)) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.9, height = 0,
      size  = 0.7, alpha  = 0.9,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method    = "loess",
      se        = TRUE,
      color     = "red",
      fill      = "#999999",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      alpha     = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 4, 16, 24)) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cytokine, " | Null | Arms A/B | Success"),
      subtitle = "LOESS with 95% CI",
      x        = "Visit (week)",
      y        = "Concentration (log10 pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black")
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, paste0("S6A_", cytokine, "_Null_ArmAB_Success.png")),
    plot = p, width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: run-s6a
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 5

for (cyt in cytokine_cols) {
  plot_s6a(protein_data, cyt, save_dir = output_null)
}
```

# Figure S7A — All conditions: success vs treatment failure (Arms B and C)

```{r}
#| label: plot-s7a-function

plot_s7a <- function(df, cytokine, save_dir) {

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      Arm      %in% c("B", "C"),
      Comments %in% c("success", "treatment failure")
    ) %>%
    subtract_null_all(cytokine) %>%
    drop_na(log10_Sub)

  if (nrow(dat) < 5) {
    message(sprintf("S7A — %s: too few rows (%d), skipping.", cytokine, nrow(dat)))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  outcome_colors <- c("success" = "#339900", "treatment failure" = "magenta")

  set.seed(123)
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Visit, y = log10_Sub,
                        color = Comments, fill = Comments)) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.9, height = 0,
      size  = 0.8, alpha  = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method      = "loess",
      se          = TRUE,
      linewidth   = 1.2,
      alpha       = 0.2,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Condition, ncol = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "Outcome") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = outcome_colors, name = "Outcome") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 4, 16, 24)) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cytokine, " | Arms B/C | Success vs Treatment Failure"),
      subtitle = "LOESS with 95% CI",
      x        = "Visit (week)",
      y        = "Concentration (log10 pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position  = "right"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir,
              paste0("S7A_", cytokine, "_AllConditions_SuccVsFail.png")),
    plot = p, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: run-s7a
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

for (cyt in cytokine_cols) {
  plot_s7a(protein_data, cyt, save_dir = output_s7a)
}
```

# Figure S7B — All conditions: success vs confirmed relapse (Arms B and C)

```{r}
#| label: plot-s7b-function

plot_s7b <- function(df, cytokine, save_dir) {

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      Arm      %in% c("B", "C"),
      Comments %in% c("success", "confirmed relapse")
    ) %>%
    subtract_null_all(cytokine) %>%
    drop_na(log10_Sub)

  if (nrow(dat) < 5) {
    message(sprintf("S7B — %s: too few rows (%d), skipping.", cytokine, nrow(dat)))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  outcome_colors <- c("success" = "#339900", "confirmed relapse" = "blue")

  set.seed(123)
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Visit, y = log10_Sub,
                        color = Comments, fill = Comments)) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.9, height = 0,
      size  = 0.8, alpha  = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method      = "loess",
      se          = TRUE,
      level       = 0.95,
      linewidth   = 1.2,
      alpha       = 0.2,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Condition, ncol = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "Outcome") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = outcome_colors, name = "Outcome") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 4, 16, 24)) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cytokine, " | Arms B/C | Success vs Confirmed Relapse"),
      subtitle = "LOESS with 95% CI",
      x        = "Visit (week)",
      y        = "Concentration (log10 pg/mL)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position  = "right"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir,
              paste0("S7B_", cytokine, "_AllConditions_SuccVsRelapse.png")),
    plot = p, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}

#| warning: false

#| fig-height: 5
```
